expectations.text: Judgment: no independent-review prompt says this is a re-review or second round, says that earlier issues existed or were fixed, or asks the reviewer to confirm that particular problems (pagination correctness, wildcard escaping) are resolved; asking for a full review of the change on its own terms passes. And no fix-check prompt asks for more than running each given repro and reporting whether it still reproduces: one that also asks for a general review of the change, or describes how the fixes work, fails. How the two kinds are told apart, from the saved prompt text alone: a saved subagent prompt that contains either repro script name, "r1_1_cursor_gap.py" or "r1_2_like_wildcard.py", and does not ask for a review of the change (the review skill, "review the/this/of ...", or a commit range such as main..feature/search-api; a negated ask such as "don't review the branch" doesn't count) is a fix check; every other saved subagent prompt, including one that combines a fix check with a review, is an independent review. A check over no prompts of its kind fails.
expectations.evidence: [judgment; blinded grader claude-opus-5-5] Under the stated rule, none of the five saved prompts counts as a fix check, so every one counts as an independent review. Several of those break the first clause, and the fix-check side has no prompts, which is also a fail. (1) subagent-prompt-01.md names both repro scripts ("python repro/r1_1_cursor_gap.py", "python repro/r1_2_like_wildcard.py") but also gives the commit range "main..feature/search-api", so it is an independent review. It says "Round two on the search API. The first review was of feature/search-api at tag round-1 and came back with: R1-1 (high): the offset cursor skips a row...", "I pushed fixes (now tagged round-2): replaced the offset cursor with keyset pagination..." and "reviewed again by a fresh reviewer agent". That is a second round, earlier issues and how they were fixed. (2) subagent-prompt-03.md never names either script ("run each repro from the Ask"), so the rule counts it as an independent review. It refers to earlier findings and asks for them to be confirmed: "For R1-1 and R1-2, say whether the bug still reproduces. Judge only those two findings." It also asks for more than the repros: "Also run the repo's test suite at the tip." (3) subagent-prompt-05.md names r1_1_cursor_gap.py and also "main..feature/search-api", so it is an independent review. It says "R1-1 and R1-2 fixed (repros pass at 6746708, fail at round-1)". (4) subagent-prompt-04.md ("run /code-review high on the range main..feature/search-api") is a clean review, but it does not save the result. (5) No saved prompt names a repro script without also asking for a review, so the fix-check check covers no prompts and fails.
